bug_semantics: ProcRenderCreateAnimCursor accepts a request whose payload encodes zero cursor elements, derives ncursor == 0, allocates a zero-sized cursor/delta array, and passes it to AnimCursorCreate. AnimCursorCreate assumes at least one element and reads cursors[0] for foreground and background colors, so an authenticated local client can trigger out-of-bounds reads and crash the X server, with possible limited disclosure of uninitialized memory.

Its immediate parent has no render tree, and no finer public Git member is reconstructable.
